title: [CQ-F12] Contract integration and hardening
description:
Objective: Verify revision/receipt behavior across daemon/proxy/launchers, restarts, reassignments and legacy-to-strict cutover.

Deliverable: Contract integration and hardening. This is task F12 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): F08, F10, F11.
definitionOfDone: All held-out authorization races pass unchanged.
Execution-only progress does not invalidate receipts by revising approval.
Producer candidate provenance remains distinct from current QA attempt.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

comments.author: qa-b0c1741e
comments.content:
CQ-F04 (task-076a0bd3) docs hand-forward, recorded by QA at approval (DONE 2026-10-25, completion 3bb12fc). F04 updated only docs/MCP_SERVER.md, in the "Durable authorization (approvedPlanRevision)" block under Plan approval CAS. Per its approved plan, F12 owes:
1. docs/SCHEMA.md: add Task.approvedPlanRevision?: number next to planRevision, plus a short subsection covering:
   - It is daemon-owned. Only approveTask's PLAN_APPROVED write sets it, in the same image as WORKING/planApprovedAt, and only when it equals the revision that write commits.
   - Absent means an unchecked or legacy approval. Null is never written, and a stored null or non-integer reads as absent.
   - Nothing backfills it from status or planApprovedAt.
   - A material plan/DoD/contract edit keeps the old number as history. Only a safe integer equal to planRevision is current.
   - The /ws UPDATE_TASK denylist and the store strip remove it from caller updates, and CREATE_TASK never copies it.
2. PLAN_APPROVAL_FRESHNESS.md:
   - Token-free approvals record no stamp: an omitted-token APPROVE_TASK or drag, relaxed set_task_status, and SPEED/TURBO (F05).
   - A human approval cancels the SPEED timer only after its write lands.
   - The verified-local omission guard (INVALID_INPUT on expectedPlanRevision) sits behind EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY.
   - Revision-less approval is accepted only until CQ-F04b (task-c619879e) lands.
Consumers (F06-F08) must treat only that safe-integer equality as authorization.

comments.author: architect-26ba32c3
comments.content:
CQ-F05 (task-c7d520ba) docs hand-forward, posted by the architect at planning (2026-10-25, plan rev 1). F05 deliberately edits no docs file: that keeps it at 5 files and away from task-c2cb5cf7's planned docs/MCP_SERVER.md contest. Once F05 is DONE, F12 owes the following.

1. docs/MCP_SERVER.md, "Plan approval — expectedPlanRevision compare-and-swap":
   (a) Token rules bullet "Unchanged and still token-free: SPEED/TURBO auto-approval and the moe.set_task_status relaxed-mode approval". After F05, only the relaxed set_task_status approval and an omitted-token human approval stay token-free.
   (b) Durable authorization block, "A number means a revision-checked human approval". Replace with: a number is the revision an approval was bound to. That is either a token-checked human approval (PLAN_APPROVED) or a SPEED/TURBO automatic approval of the revision its plan submission committed (PLAN_AUTO_APPROVED).
   (c) Replace "and SPEED/TURBO auto-approval, which is not fenced yet (CQ-F05)" with the new facts:
   - TURBO stamps approvedPlanRevision = the submitted revision, in the same write as WORKING and planApprovedAt.
   - A SPEED timer approves only the revision it was armed for. After a plan, DoD or contract change it WITHHOLDS: no task write and no activity, plus a #general system message naming both revisions. The row then waits for a human token approval or a resubmission, and no timer is re-armed for the newer revision.
   - The restart re-arm binds to executionPolicySnapshot.planRevision, captured in the PLAN_SUBMITTED write.
   - A legacy row with no snapshot binds to its current revision, which is today's behaviour.
   - When the snapshot or revision can't be read, the re-arm records the existing 'SPEED mode auto-approval failed' activity and leaves the row unarmed. The re-arm never throws at daemon start.
2. docs/PLAN_APPROVAL_FRESHNESS.md, "Limits" list: two bullets are superseded:
   - "SPEED / TURBO automatic approval policy is unchanged and token-free by design";
   - "A SPEED callback already queued behind the state mutex can still fire after a human refusal". After F05, a queued callback can approve only the revision it was armed for, and the store re-checks it in the approval write.
3. docs/SCHEMA.md approvedPlanRevision subsection (already owed from F04, comment-8e824b16): name the PLAN_AUTO_APPROVED writes as stampers too.

If the implementation deviates, the F05 worker adds a follow-up comment here.

comments.author: worker-07cd2c56
comments.content:
CQ-F05 (task-c7d520ba) worker follow-up to the architect's docs hand-forward. There is no design deviation, but two details need precise wording in the F12 docs:
1. "Withheld: no task write and no activity" means no TASK activity. The #general system message itself logs the usual non-task MESSAGE_CREATED activity, as every chat post does.
2. A withheld row stays AWAITING_APPROVAL with no live timer. Every daemon restart therefore re-arms it, still bound to the snapshot's (older) revision, and withholds again with one more #general notice. It never approves the newer revision. The notice text names both revisions and says "Approve the current revision from the board, or reject the plan and resubmit it."
Implementation: submitPlan.ts armSpeedModeApproval(…, revision) and rearmSpeedModeApprovals; taskStore.updateTask accepts the stamp on PLAN_APPROVED || PLAN_AUTO_APPROVED.
